en.topic_title: Buildings Dep’t launches 259 prosecutions over works at fire-hit Wang Fuk Court, 9 months after fatal blaze
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s Buildings Department (BD) has launched more than 200 prosecutions against four individuals and two companies that oversaw renovation works at the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court.



Wang Fuk Court. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



The 259 charges, covering the use of defective or substandard materials and failure to adequately supervise renovation works, were initiated on Wednesday – more than nine months after the fire broke out.
